title: Average US body temperature by birth era

source.name: Decreasing human body temperature in the United States since the industrial revolution (Protsiv et al., eLife 2020)

notes: Protsiv et al. (eLife, 2020) measured men's average body temperature falling about 1.06F comparing men born in the early 1800s to men born in the 1990s, after adjusting for age, height, weight and time of day. Values here apply that measured drop to the traditional 98.6F reference point to show the scale of the shift.
